# Index Estimation for the NWFSC WCGBT Survey {#wcgbt-index-settings}


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

raw_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pfmc-assessments/indexwc/refs/heads/main/data-raw/configuration.csv"
configuration <- read.csv(raw_url)

survey <- dplyr::filter(configuration, source == "NWFSC.Combo")
sp_2025 <- c("canary rockfish", "chilipepper", "rougheye rockfish", "sablefish", "widow rockfish", "yelloweye rockfish", "yellowtail rockfish")
survey_2025 <- dplyr::filter(survey, species %in% sp_2025 & used == TRUE)
survey_other <- dplyr::filter(survey, !species %in% sp_2025)
survey <- rbind(survey_2025, survey_other) |>
  dplyr::arrange(tolower(species))


# Need to update the used column so there is one record from each species/wcgbts retained!
survey_mat <- survey |>
#  dplyr::filter(source == "NWFSC.Combo", used == TRUE) |>
  dplyr::select(-fxn, -source, -min_depth, -max_depth, -min_year, -max_year, -anisotropy, -knots, -share_range, -used) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    min_latitude = round(min_latitude, 1),
    max_latitude = round(max_latitude, 1)
  )
survey_mat[, "family"] <- gsub("sdmTMB::", "", survey_mat[, "family"])
col_names <- gsub("_", " ", colnames(survey_mat))
ind <- order(survey_mat$species)

sa4ss::table_format(
  x = survey_mat[ind, ], 
  caption = "Setting used for estimating indices of abundance for the NWFSC WCGBT survey by species.",
  label = 'survey-settings',
  col_names = col_names,
  landscape = TRUE,
  font_size = 7,
  custom_width = TRUE,
	col_to_adjust = 1:ncol(survey),
  #width = c('0.1 cm', rep('2.5 cm', 2), rep('4 cm', 1), rep('1 cm', nrow(survey_mat) - 4)),
  width = c('3 cm', '2 cm', '4 cm', '2 cm', '2 cm', '2 cm', '2 cm'),
  align = 'l')

```
